chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, entered upon Aisha while she was counting the bread, and he said: "O Humayra', do not count, lest it be counted against you."

key_terms.الْخُبْزَ: bread, referring here to stored food or provision
key_terms.حُمَيْرَاءُ: a form of address used here in the narration
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, namely the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.فَيُحْصَى عَلَيْكِ: then it will be counted against you, meaning one is taken to account for such behavior

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about counting food and provisions?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a moral lesson against excessive counting and anxious hoarding of provision. It encourages trust, generosity, and avoidance of a miserly attitude regarding sustenance.
